_note: The one fact sheet. The footer, src/lib/schema.ts, src/pages/llms.txt.ts and src/config.ts read from here. Paste the description unchanged into every outside profile. No phone number, company details or price goes in this file. The one award is the named entry under award, read off the trophy photograph; add no other.
description: Mr Wallcover is a London specialist wallcovering installer founded by Dorin Burcus, in the trade since 2012: survey to aftercare for hotels, homes and makers.
_region: The region London sits in, for the schema PostalAddress (addressLocality London, addressRegion Greater London, addressCountry GB). Locality, region and country only: never a street, postcode or private address.
coverage: London and the surrounding areas; UK-wide for selected projects
_lastReviewed: ISO date of the last site-wide copy review. Pages without a date of their own (guides and case studies carry theirs) show this as 'Last reviewed'. Move it forward when the copy is reviewed again; never backdate it.
_award: Read off the trophy photograph published in June 2022 and archived by the Wayback Machine (url). The trophy reads: BUILD 2021 Design & Build Awards, Most Outstanding for Wallcovering Installation, 2021, @MrWallcover. Print the line exactly as text; never shorten it to an unnamed award.
_programmeFigures: Programme figures Dorin cleared on 11 Oct 2026, each from a caption on our own Instagram (@mrwallcover) and cited in docs/sources.md. Add no figure that is not on Dorin's list. 'figure' and 'where' are the short labels the homepage proof strip prints; an entry without them (e.g. a duration) is not a figure and stays off the strip.

programmeFigures.fact: Raffles London at The OWO: chosen in 2021 to install about 17,500 m² of wallcoverings in 18 months
Four Seasons Hotel London at Ten Trinity Square: about 5,000 m² of wallcoverings, completed in 2019
The Biltmore Mayfair (then the Millennium Hotel, Grosvenor Square): a guest-room programme of more than 15,000 m² in 2018
Pendley Manor Hotel: 30 rooms in 30 days, with 20 different wallpapers
DoubleTree by Hilton London – West End: 30 rooms on two floors in 2019, while the hotel stayed open
Jumeirah Carlton Tower, Knightsbridge: wallcovering installation on the hotel's renovation for 8 months, completed at the end of 2020
